methodology.selection: Seed 94217; one page per work/creator, stratified by format; favor colored surfaces and include seeded controls. Original split preserved; no overlapping evaluation groups. Seven mixed-color groups narrowed to source lines; one multicolor logo excluded before scoring.
methodology.oracle: Assistant visual review and populated original RGB swatches, frozen before predictions. Not human gold. Text boxes originate in silver OCR labels and were visually checked.
methodology.metric: Maximum per-channel sRGB error <= 25 against an accepted observed color. Missing estimates count as errors. Gradient text may have two accepted source colors.
methodology.scope: Controlled source color sampling with supplied boxes; not OCR, provider, device, or 20,000-page accuracy.
methodology.holdout: 45 work-disjoint cases. The cyan outlined-title regression found during validation was corrected; this is a reviewed regression set, not an untouched statistical test set.
methodology.confirmation: 20 additional work-disjoint crops (seed 190423), labeled before baseline/candidate evaluation after the algorithm was fixed; no quality tuning on these cases.
